cushion.source: root chair surface report (actual UE cushion triangles)

source_meta.ue_component_from_gltf: UE cm = 100 * (x, z, y); world = BodyWorld(yaw 180) * component

rules.seat_regions: AnalyzeCapturedSeatSkin: region weight >= 0.30 and largest of 5
rules.soles: root fixed native plantar witness (4171), identified by nearest posed owner vertex
rules.fingers: AnalyzeCapturedFingerSkin: distal "3" joint weight >= 0.30, left first

solve.rule: smallest pitch with >= 0.4 cm margin at both band edges; chair dy: smallest pitch, ties to the earlier candidate
solve.solved_on: all 495 captured keys of room_mx_typing (0..16.47 s)

left_sole.unseated_note: stepping frames lift a foot genuinely; only penetration is counted there

right_sole.unseated_note: stepping frames lift a foot genuinely; only penetration is counted there

capsule.chair_collision_data: component AABB only (no collision primitives in the report)
capsule.recommended: Keep the CharacterMovement capsule at the approach point (standing size, collision on) and drive the mesh by the clip's hips root motion into the seat (no capsule move, no teleport, no collision disable). While seated the capsule stays at the approach point; the mesh offset from capsule is the SitDown hips travel. GetUp reverses it and ends at the same approach point.

seated_capsule_option.note: a capsule at the seated hips XY overlaps the chair AABB by construction; it may only be used with a collision channel that ignores the owned chair actor, which counts as a bypass -> NOT recommended

root_audit_required: sweep the standing capsule at the approach point against the actual chair and desk collision (component AABB clearance above is only conservative-by-AABB)

audit.times: DeskTyping 3..8 s @60 Hz (301, the native audit)
